cells.gaps: Nothing found after October 2024 says the CitizenApp is still in use; the Ghana Card e-wallet is to be activated in phases.
cells.note: The CitizenApp (CADIS), launched on 7 October 2024, creates a digital ID from the Ghana Card and NIA data with biometric sign-on to public services (GHA-042, GHA-041), and NIA verification serves GRA, NHIS, the Passport Office and banks (GHA-034). Top rung.
